title: 港府顾问Alan：行政长官获赞最佳，兰桂坊如何适应新变化？
speaker: Alan

segments.en: You advised the chief executive, John Lee. What is he thinking in terms of his political future? Does he want to see through this five-year plan?
segments.zh: 你为行政长官李家超提供建议。他对自己的政治前途有什么想法？他想完成这个五年规划吗？

segments.en: Off the record. Yes. I think, I think he worked very hard. Well, he was on TV yesterday for three hours.
segments.zh: 非正式地说。是的。我认为他工作非常努力。他昨天在电视上待了三个小时。

segments.en: Yeah, 100,000 words. And so does he want to seek a second?
segments.zh: 是的，10万字。那么他想寻求连任吗？

segments.en: He's done a very, very good job. And he's very strong. And he's, he's very good.
segments.zh: 他做得非常非常好。他非常坚强。他非常优秀。

segments.en: I've been an advisor to every chief executive since Tom Chiwa, every single one of them. And I could tell you of all of them, he's the best.
segments.zh: 自董建华以来，我担任过每一位行政长官的顾问，每一位都是。我可以告诉你，在所有人中，他是最好的。

segments.en: I've said this publicly as well. So this is in the secret. He is open-minded. He's got the ability. He's very smart.
segments.zh: 我也公开说过这一点。所以这不是秘密。他思想开放。他有能力。他非常聪明。

segments.en: And he gets it immediately. You have an idea. He'll, he'll, he'll make it happen. And he, we're lucky to have somebody like him.
segments.zh: 他立刻就能理解。你有一个想法，他会让它实现。我们很幸运有像他这样的人。

segments.en: And that's why he's somebody who can really make this happen, really take this forward.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么他是能够真正实现这一点、真正推动这件事向前的人。

segments.en: I got to get your take on Long Quai Phong. I mean, there, there's this narrative that it's done. It's, you know, you're not seeing the same bankers, the streets anymore that in some ways the expat mix is very different.
segments.zh: 我想听听你对兰桂坊的看法。有一种说法是它已经承压。你不再看到同样的银行家，街道上，某种程度上外籍人士的构成非常不同。

segments.en: People are not drinking as much. I mean, how do you adapt to what looks to be a very different night scene?
segments.zh: 人们喝酒不像以前那么多了。我的意思是，你如何适应看起来非常不同的夜生活场景？

segments.en: You adapt because things change. I've been there 40 years now. And so I've been through the ups and downs. But, you know, after COVID, of course, everybody was, was heard. And then 200,000 expats left Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 你适应是因为事情在变化。我在那里已经40年了。所以我经历了起起落落。但是，你知道，新冠疫情之后，当然，每个人都受到了影响。然后20万外籍人士离开了香港。
